title: M5.10 BDS — one small, bounded improvement

steps.title: One small improvement
steps.instruction:
Inspect the existing bdsdanang repository.
Identify one small, concrete improvement that can be safely implemented
without changing the overall architecture.
Implement only that improvement.
Run the relevant tests/typecheck.
Produce a concise report containing:
- files inspected
- files changed
- what changed
- tests/typechecks executed
- results
- remaining issues.

Do not expand scope.
Do not perform unrelated refactoring.
Do not modify infrastructure unless required for the selected small fix.

Safety limits for this first real run:
- Do not read, print or modify .dev.vars, .env files or any other secret or credential file.
- Do not deploy, publish, run database migrations, or run wrangler commands that contact Cloudflare.
- Do not install, add, remove or upgrade dependencies.
- Do not run git commit, git push, git reset, git checkout, git stash or git clean.
- Do not modify files that already had uncommitted changes before this task, unless the selected fix requires it; if it does, say so in the report.
